description: This Java class defines a GUI panel, MessagesPane, used in an application to display messages, handle font customization, and include various UI components like buttons, labels, and panels. It interacts with configuration storage and external components to construct and manage the message display interface.

classes.name: MessagesPane
classes.description: A GUI panel class that displays messages, allows font customization, and includes controls for recent commands and help links.

methods.name: MessagesPane
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message pane components, sets up layout, and registers event handlers for font button.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main content panel of the message pane.

methods.name: getTabSelectedListener
methods.description: Provides an ActionListener that sets focus to the command input when the tab is selected.
